title: A browser MMORPG
author: Simple_Day_1311
selftext:
A browser MMORPG running at 60 fps with zero downloads. Built completely from scratch—no Unity, Unreal, or third-party engines.

​Here’s a quick look at what’s live right now: real-time multiplayer, combat, shops, inventory, and drops.

​Most people write off the browser for multiplayer games thinking it won't scale or that latency will ruin it. Turns out if you optimize the stack from the start, it just works.

​I'm running the first server tests in a few days. If you want to check it out or follow along, join the Discord here:

[https://discord.gg/6SbkqyHKs](https://discord.gg/6SbkqyHKs)
